dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Maalaus? You're here too? We didn't expect to run into you on the moon!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So Columbina brought you here, right? She did say she'd take you to the moon for your exhibition.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Right, speaking of the exhibition... where are your paintings?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What's wrong? Don't tell me... they're lost?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: How could that happen? We're on the moon! They couldn't have been stolen, right...?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Anyway, let's help Maalaus look for them first. Maybe they just got left somewhere nearby.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Maalaus, look! We found all your paintings and brought them back!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe, no need to thank us. We had a hand in these paintings too, after all.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Since when can you understand what Maalaus is saying, Paimon?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Come on, we've been to the Silvermoon Hall together so many times already. It's not that surprising I'd start getting what Maalaus means, right?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So what did Maalaus say happened to the paintings?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh... well... let Paimon try to interpret... Maalaus says...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Maybe other kuuhenki stole them...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Mm... or maybe those fancy transport things on the moon took them...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Or... maybe Columbina stole them...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Hey! That's definitely not true!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Oh... did I get it wrong after all...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So it was just wild guessing...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmph. Learning a foreign language isn't that easy, you know...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: All Paimon needs is a good teacher! When the time comes, Paimon's gonna get Columbina to teach her properly!
